exposure: mode of delivery (Caesarean section, vaginal delivery)
cohort: The study included 1302 Korean adolescents aged from 12 to 18 years.
finding: Atopic dermatitis in adolescents was significantly associated with Caesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Adolescents born by Caesarean section had a significantly higher odds of atopic dermatitis compared to those born by vaginal delivery (OR = 1.61, 95% CI = 1.05-2.47), while asthma was not associated with mode of delivery.
